body:
Please report the Pygments finding to the Pygments maintainers; the audit identifies it in that dependency. The Requests finding applies to applications that call `requests.utils.extract_zipped_paths()` directly. For a private report about a vulnerability in Rich itself, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
